Card Q&A.a: No, it can't. It can only digivolve into a card with both the [Aquatic] and [LIBERATOR] traits.
Card Q&A.q: If I would use this card's  effect to digivolve my Digimon, can it digivolve into a Digimon card with the [Aquatic] or [LIBERATOR] trait?

Effect: [Main] You may play 1 [Sangomon] or [Yao Qinglan] from your hand or trash without paying the cost. Then, place this card in the battle area.
[Your Turn] When any of your [Yao Qinglan] suspend, ＜Delay＞.
・1 of your Digimon with [Aqua] or [Sea Animal] in any of its traits may digivolve into an [Aquatic] and [LIBERATOR] trait Digimon card in the hand with the digivolution cost reduced by 3.
